projects.title: Fire Safety College IMS
projects.description: A comprehensive college management system designed to streamline academic and administrative operations for a Fire Safety Institute. Working on backend architecture, REST APIs, authentication, role-based access, student management, examinations, fees and institutional workflows.
highlights: Modular backend architecture using MVC principles
Student, faculty and academic management APIs
Examination and exam form submission workflows
Fee eligibility validation and pending fee management
API testing, debugging and database integration
